about: One-click display filters for the Packets tab. Every filter is Wireshark syntax and picks the same packets in Wireshark (tests/test_templates.py checks each against the engine; python -m anta.tools.compare_filters against tshark).

templates.name: TCP problems
templates.about: Everything TCP analysis flags except window updates: retransmissions, lost segments, duplicate ACKs, zero windows, resets of kept-alive connections. Wireshark's "Bad TCP" coloring rule.

templates.name: Retransmissions
templates.about: Data sent again because it was lost or not acknowledged in time.

templates.name: Lost segments and duplicate ACKs
templates.about: Gaps in the data and the receiver asking for what is missing: packet loss on the path.

templates.name: Receiver full (zero window)
templates.about: A receiver that stopped reading, so the sender has to wait: a slow or stuck application, not the network.

templates.name: Connection resets
templates.about: Connections refused or torn down abruptly.

templates.name: Connection attempts
templates.about: Every new TCP connection a client tried to open (answered or not).

templates.name: ICMP errors
templates.about: Unreachable hosts, ports and networks, firewalls that reject, and packets that ran out of hops (TTL exceeded).

templates.name: Fragmented IP
templates.about: IPv4 packets split into fragments: MTU problems, or traffic built to slip past inspection.

templates.name: Database errors
templates.about: Errors returned by MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server: failed queries, missing tables, denied logins.

templates.name: HTTP errors
templates.about: HTTP responses 400 and above: not found, forbidden, server errors.

templates.name: DNS failures
templates.about: DNS answers that are errors: no such name, server failure, refused.

templates.name: Slow DNS answers
templates.about: DNS responses that took more than half a second.

templates.name: Slow web responses
templates.about: HTTP responses that came more than a second after their request.

templates.name: TLS alerts
templates.about: A TLS side giving up on the handshake (unknown certificate, no shared cipher...). TLS 1.3 encrypts its alerts after the hello, so only early ones show.

templates.name: Login failures
templates.filter: kerberos.error_code == 24 || ldap.resultCode == 49 || smb2.nt_status == 0xc000006d || ftp.response.code == 530 || http.response.code == 401 || mysql.error_code == 1045 || pgsql.code == "28P01"
templates.about: Wrong passwords across Kerberos, LDAP, SMB, FTP, HTTP, MySQL and PostgreSQL. Many in a row from one host is password guessing.

templates.name: SMB errors
templates.about: SMB2/3 replies with an error status (access denied, no such file...), leaving out the normal "more processing required" of a logon.

templates.name: Malformed packets
templates.about: Packets that break their protocol's rules: corruption, truncation, or crafted traffic.

templates.name: Broadcast
templates.about: Frames sent to every device on the segment.

templates.name: Broadcast and multicast
templates.about: Frames sent to a group of devices rather than one.

templates.name: Discovery chatter
templates.filter: arp || mdns || ssdp || llmnr || nbns || browser || lldp || cdp || stp
templates.about: Devices announcing and looking for each other: ARP, mDNS/Bonjour, SSDP/UPnP, LLMNR, NetBIOS, LLDP, CDP, spanning tree.

templates.name: Hide the noise
templates.filter: !(arp || mdns || ssdp || llmnr || nbns || browser || lldp || cdp || stp || eth.dst == ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff)
templates.about: Everything except broadcasts and discovery chatter.

templates.name: Logins and user names
templates.filter: ftp.request.command in {"USER", "PASS"} || ntlmssp.auth.username || kerberos.CNameString || mysql.user || pgsql.parameter_name == "user"
templates.about: Where accounts appear: FTP logins (in clear text), NTLM and Kerberos user names, database logins.

templates.name: Plain-text web requests
templates.about: Unencrypted HTTP requests: what was fetched, from where, by which program.

templates.name: Program downloads
templates.about: Requests for programs and scripts by name, and responses declared as Windows programs.

templates.name: TLS server names
templates.about: Every TLS Client Hello: which server name each encrypted connection asked for.

templates.name: DNS queries
templates.about: Every name looked up.

templates.name: Remote access
templates.about: SSH, RDP, VNC and Telnet: remote shells and desktops.

templates.name: Database traffic
templates.about: MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server conversations.
